# remove at people

# remove punctuation

# remove numbers

some_txt = gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", some_txt)

try.error = function(x)
{
# create missing value
y = NA
# tryCatch error
try_error = tryCatch(tolower(x), error=function(e) e)
# if not an error
if (!inherits(try_error, "error"))
y = tolower(x)
# result
return(y)
}
# lower case using try.error with sapply
